analysis: The trial crashed after consuming 5.42 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was produced, so this experiment provides no evidence of improvement or regression. The supplied traceback reports only that train.py exited unsuccessfully; it does not expose the underlying exception. A failure in initialization or pretraining diagnostics is possible but unconfirmed. The reported parent host HR@10 of 0.6275 is historical context, not this trial’s result.
code_summary: One independently trained LightGCN model per category combines graph user embeddings with gated, recency-aware history attention. The added branch stably compacts valid chronological events while preserving repeats, applies a left-padded three-event Conv1d followed by GELU and a zero-initialized output projection, and adds its output to history values and attention keys. The latest-item query retains the original propagated item vector. Candidate embeddings remain tied to graph item vectors with learned item biases. Initialization preserves the parent RNG stream. Diagnostics check masking, initial parent parity, causality, gradients, padding, and strict serialization. The predictor reconstructs and strictly loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category. Training splits, sampling, optimization, seeds, category routing, and stopping rules remain unchanged.
